docs:
Alert displays a static status or informational message.
Renders a live region with role=status by default; children carry the message body.

parts.name: Alert
parts.docs: Alert renders a div with alert or status semantics.

docs:
Badge shows a short status label.
Badge uses variant and size presets.

parts.name: Badge
parts.docs: Badge renders label text in a div wrapper.

props.name: Variant
props.docs: color preset: default, secondary, destructive, outline

docs:
Block is the one semantic root of a file (div, section, article, aside, header, footer, main, nav, figure, search, hgroup).
Any file (block, composite, screen) may open on one Block; never nest Block inside Block in one file, never repeat it in a loop.

parts.name: Block
parts.docs: Block renders a resolved landmark element with children.

props.name: Tag
props.docs: semantic tag: div (default), section, article, aside, header, footer, main, nav, figure, search, hgroup

docs:
Box is a generic layout wrapper for internal sections.
Not for top-level landmarks — use Block for page regions.

parts.name: Box
parts.docs: Box renders a div layout wrapper.

props.name: Tag
props.docs: div only. Use Block for landmarks (aside, section, header, nav).

docs:
Breadcrumb shows the current page location within a hierarchy.
Renders nav with ordered links and aria-current on the active item.

parts.name: Breadcrumb
parts.docs: Breadcrumb renders the full navigation trail.

props.name: DataUI8Kit
props.docs: opt-in behavior hook; empty emits nothing

docs: ButtonPlain is a bare button element: no styling beyond Class. Patterns (tabs, tree rows, menu items) style it themselves.

parts.name: ButtonPlain
parts.docs: ButtonPlain is a bare button element: no styling beyond Class. Patterns (tabs, tree rows, menu items) style it themselves.

props.name: Type
props.docs: button type: button, submit, reset (ignored when Href is set)

docs:
Button triggers an action on click.
Optional Href renders an anchor with button appearance (CTA navigation).
For exotic roots, use ButtonClasses (Templ/Svelte/Vue/Solid) or asChild (React).
Prefer Link for prose/semantic navigation.

parts.name: Button
parts.docs:
Button renders a button element, or an anchor when Href is set.
Type/Form apply only in button mode; Disabled on anchors uses aria-disabled.

props.name: Variant
props.docs: appearance preset: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link

props.name: Size
props.docs: density preset: default, sm, lg, icon

props.name: Type
props.docs: button type: button, submit, reset (ignored when Href is set)

props.name: Form
props.docs: links button to a form id (ignored when Href is set)

props.name: Href
props.docs: when set, renders an anchor with button appearance

props.name: Rel
props.docs: explicit rel; external links default to noopener noreferrer (anchor mode)

props.name: External
props.docs: opens in a new tab with safe rel defaults (anchor mode)

docs:
Card groups related content in one bordered surface.
Card uses header, content, and footer slots.
For semantic root elements (section, article), use CardClasses on a manual wrapper.

parts.name: Card
parts.docs: Card renders the bordered surface wrapper.

parts.name: CardHeader
parts.docs: CardHeader renders the top slot.

parts.name: CardTitle
parts.docs: CardTitle renders heading text at the As level (default h2).

parts.name: CardDescription
parts.docs: CardDescription renders a muted subtitle in a p element.

parts.name: CardContent
parts.docs: CardContent renders the padded main body slot.

parts.name: CardFooter
parts.docs: CardFooter renders the bottom action slot.

docs:
Checkbox is a native boolean form control.
Wireframe styling via Variant and Size; supports standard ARIA attrs.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.docs: Checkbox renders a styled input[type=checkbox].

docs:
Container wraps page content with a constrained width shell.
Optional main or section tag for inner layout regions.

parts.name: Container
parts.docs: Container renders the outer content shell.

docs: Form controls covers fieldset, legend, datalist, output, meter, and progress.

parts.docs: Fieldset renders a native fieldset.

parts.name: Legend
parts.docs: Legend renders a native legend.

parts.name: DataList
parts.docs: DataList renders a native datalist.

parts.name: DataOption
parts.docs: DataOption renders an option inside a datalist.

parts.name: Output
parts.docs: Output renders a native output element.

parts.name: Meter
parts.docs: Meter renders a native meter.

parts.name: Progress
parts.docs: Progress renders a native progress element.

docs:
Dialog renders a native dialog root with an optional behavior hook.
The data-ui8kit hook defaults off; the registry ships no client JS.

parts.name: Dialog
parts.docs: Dialog renders a native dialog element.

props.name: DataUI8Kit
props.docs: opt-in behavior hook; empty emits nothing

docs:
Disclosure renders native details and summary elements.
Open is a static attribute only — no controlled-state contract.

parts.name: Disclosure
parts.docs: Disclosure renders native details.

props.name: Name
props.docs: group name: details of one name open one at a time (native exclusive accordion); leave out for independent items

parts.name: Summary
parts.docs: Summary renders native summary, followed by a Lucide chevron-down indicator that turns over when the details open (CSS only: group-open:rotate-180 on the Disclosure group).

docs:
Form primitives: form wrapper, field item, description, and validation message.
Composes with Label, Input, and other controls.

parts.name: Form
parts.docs: Form renders a vertical grid form container.

parts.name: FormItem
parts.docs: FormItem groups a single field with spacing for label and control.

parts.name: FormDescription
parts.docs: FormDescription renders muted helper copy below a control.

parts.name: FormMessage
parts.docs: FormMessage renders destructive validation feedback.

docs: Grid lays out children in a CSS grid with optional column wrappers.

parts.name: Grid
parts.docs: Grid renders a display:grid container.

parts.name: GridCol
parts.docs: GridCol renders one grid column child.

docs:
Group arranges children in a horizontal flex row.
Supports fieldset for related form controls.

parts.name: Group
parts.docs: Group renders a horizontal flex container.

props.name: Gap
props.docs: sets gap: a Tailwind spacing step (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 = gap-N) or auto

props.name: Tag
props.docs: div, fieldset, or dl. Use fieldset for related form controls.

docs:
Icon renders a class-based span, svg use reference, or text fallback.
Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology by default.

parts.name: Icon
parts.docs: Icon renders a class-based span, svg use, or text fallback host.

props.name: Name
props.docs: icon name appended to Prefix in class mode

props.name: BaseClass
props.docs: base icon font class in class mode

props.name: Prefix
props.docs: icon font prefix in class mode

props.name: Href
props.docs: svg use href in svg mode

props.name: Decorative
props.docs: hides the icon from assistive technology

docs:
IconBadge renders a small icon surface for nav rows, cards, and status blocks.
Pass the letter, glyph, or Icon node as children.

parts.name: IconBadge
parts.docs: IconBadge renders children as the badge content.

docs:
Image renders accessible img, picture, and source primitives.
Use Decorative for purely visual images so alt stays empty.

parts.name: Image
parts.docs: Image renders an accessible img element.

props.name: Decorative
props.docs: marks the image as purely presentational

parts.name: Picture
parts.docs: Picture renders a responsive image wrapper.

parts.name: Source
parts.docs: Source renders a source candidate for picture, video, or audio.

docs:
Inline renders inline copy as a span. Use Text for paragraph blocks and
Title (as 1–6) for headings.

parts.name: Inline
parts.docs: Inline renders a span element with inline copy classes.

docs:
Input is a single-line native text field.
Supports types, validation attrs, and wireframe variant/size classes.

parts.name: Input
parts.docs: Input renders a styled single-line form control.

docs: Label associates visible text with a form control via the for attribute.

parts.name: Label
parts.docs: Label renders accessible text linked to a control.

docs: Break renders br or wbr for controlled inline wrapping.

parts.name: Break
parts.docs: Break renders br by default, or wbr when Type is wbr/word.

docs: LinkPlain is a bare anchor: no styling beyond Class.

parts.name: LinkPlain
parts.docs: LinkPlain is a bare anchor: no styling beyond Class.

props.docs: explicit rel; external links default to noopener noreferrer

props.docs: opens in a new tab with safe rel defaults

Use Button for actions; use Link for destinations.

props.name: Rel
props.docs: explicit rel; external links default to noopener noreferrer

props.docs: visually and semantically disables the link

parts.docs: ListItem renders one li with optional value attribute.

props.name: Value
props.docs: optional li value for ordered contexts

docs: LucideIcon renders a Lucide glyph (ISC license) by kebab-case name from the generated registry specs/assets/lucide-icons.json. Decorative (aria-hidden) unless a Label is given.

parts.name: LucideIcon
parts.docs: LucideIcon renders an svg glyph by name.

props.name: Name
props.docs: kebab-case Lucide name; an unknown name draws a circle

props.name: Size
props.docs: width and height in px, 16 by default

props.name: Label
props.docs: accessible name; without it the icon is decorative

docs: Radio is a native single-choice control within a named group.

parts.name: Radio
parts.docs: Radio renders input[type=radio] with shared Name for grouping.

docs: Range renders a styled input[type=range] (single thumb slider). The value is controlled from outside: Value in, an input event out (canary used a bindable prop).

parts.name: Range
parts.docs: Range renders input type=range.

props.docs: current value as a string, controlled by the caller

docs: Select is a native dropdown built from Option items.

parts.docs: Select renders option children from the Options list plus manual children.

parts.docs: SelectOption renders an option for custom Select children.

parts.name: OptGroup
parts.docs: OptGroup renders a native optgroup around option children.

docs: Separator renders a semantic or decorative hr.

parts.docs: Separator renders hr with optional decorative semantics.

props.docs: hides the rule from assistive technology

Default layout primitive for spacing sections and form fields.

parts.docs: Stack renders a vertical flex container.

props.docs: sets gap: a Tailwind spacing step (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 = gap-N) or auto

Use for on/off settings; wireframe uses native checkbox styling.

parts.name: Switch

Text renders body copy: a paragraph by default; Tag picks another text element (blockquote, figcaption, address, pre, or an
inline element). Title (as 1–6) is for headings.

Title renders a heading (h1–h6) from As (1–6). Defaults to h2 when As is 0
or out of range.
